ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

metadata.description: At Fort Street High School, our events are an important part of your child’s learning and school experience. They help students build confidence, connect with others and celebrate their progress. Events also give families a chance to be involved in school life and share in their child’s achievements.

visibleTextNormalized: Events School events bring learning to life and help shape our school culture. They help students build confidence, connect with others and celebrate their progress. Events also give families a chance to be involved in school life and share in their child’s achievements. Our school event may include: school orientation days sports carnivals open day and school tours Harmony Week and Book Week events excursions and incursions performances, concerts or school productions fundraising, charity and community events award assemblies graduation and other celebrations. Contact us to learn more about our events. Important Calendar Dates to start 2027 Wednesday 3 February All students return to school. Year 7 first day For Year 7 - Introduction to Fort Street High School commences at 9:00am. Monday February 8 Swimming Carnival Canterbury Leisure & Aquatic Centre Wednesday 10 – Friday 12 February Year 7 Camp Information will be provided to parents and carers before the end of Term 4, 2026. Wednesday 10 – Friday 12 February Year 11 Camp Information will be provided to parents and carers before the end of Term 4, 2026. Wednesday 24 February School Photographs Day Information and Photo Sheets will be sent home for parents/carers to place their order and return to the photographer on the day. Students are to wear full school uniform which includes the school tie. Tuesday 2 March Catchup Photographs Day For students absent on School Photographs Day, this will be the final opportunity to have their individual photo taken. Friday 26 February; commencing at 10:00am Speech Day at the State Theatre The annual school Speech Day is a compulsory event for all students. Students must be in full school uniform at this event which includes the school tie. A permission to attend note will be sent to all parents/carers. Year 7 students make their way to State Theatre and released at the end of Speech Day, around 1:00pm. Roll Call will occur before students enter State Theatre. Parents will receive a text message if their child is unexplained absence or have arrived late. Students who require teacher supervision will be escorted back to school until 3.15pm. Featured events See what’s happening at our school. Visit Our community to volunteer at our events. There will be a photo booth and trick or treating. Secondhand Uniform Stall Date: Friday 6 November Time: Students only from 12:45pm. Parents/Carers are welcome from 1pm. This is a cashless, card only event. Year 7 Gala Day Date: Thursday 5 November Rememberance Day and SRC Induction Assembly Date: Wednesday 11 November P&C Annual General Meeting Date: Wednesday 11 November Time: In the school library from 7.30pm You are invited to attend the P&C General Meeting in the School Library. All community members are very welcome. Need to pay for an excursion or extra-curricular activity? Our parent portal makes it easy. We hope your study is going well but that you are also taking time to look after yourselves. Eat well, get plenty of sleep, take breaks and reach out for support when you need it. See you all on Tuesday 13 October 2026 for the first English exam. Remember to be early not just on time. https://www.facebook.com/share/r/14qQd4NQLBt/ We are very proud to share that two of our students, Hyejeong and Clara have been nominated for the ENCORE HSC Showcase. ENCORE presents a selection of outstanding major works by HSC Music students in NSW including performance, composition and musicology. Selected students will take perform at the Sydney Opera House. Congratulations Hyejeong and Clara! Newsletters Read our latest newsletter and stay connected with our school life.
